header: Migrating warm indexes to cold storage
content:
If you have data in UltraWarm that you query infrequently, consider migrating it to cold storage.
Cold storage is meant for data you only access occasionally or is no longer in active use. You can't
read from or write to cold indexes, but you can migrate them back to warm storage at no cost
whenever you need to query them. For instructions, see Migrating indexes to cold storage.
